The café, next door to the bakery

Stay a while, on Buckingham Street

Connected to the bakery is a spacious café with ample seating — an à la carte menu, cabinet food, light lunches and ice cream, plus outdoor seating on fine days.

It’s a firm locals’ favourite in picturesque Arrowtown, on the banks of the Arrow River — and a natural stop before a walk around the historic gold-mining town.

  • World-famous pies, baked fresh
  • Spacious café with ample seating
  • À la carte menu & cabinet food
  • Outdoor seating · takeaway available

Come early — the pies sell out.

Our more popular pies go fast, so make your visit early in the day. Questions, catering or a big order? Email us.
